labels.authorizationRequest: {clientName} requests access to your account. Sign in to allow it.

tooltips.isConfidential: A confidential client authenticates with its client secret. A public client, such as a browser or mobile application, cannot keep a secret.
tooltips.clientCredentialsGrant: The client obtains an access token on its own behalf with its client ID and secret, without a user. It acts as the selected user.
tooltips.authorizationCodeGrant: The client obtains an access token on behalf of a user who signs in on the AtroCore sign-in page (with PKCE).
tooltips.refreshTokenGrant: Together with the access token the client gets a refresh token, which it exchanges for a new access token without signing the user in again.
tooltips.user: The user the client acts as when it obtains an access token with its own credentials (client credentials grant).
tooltips.redirectUris: The addresses the user is returned to after signing in. The redirect_uri of an authorization request must match one of them exactly.
tooltips.isConsentRequired: The user confirms on the sign-in page that the application gets access to the account. Turn it off only for the applications of your own organization, such as the AtroCore user interface.
tooltips.isUiClient: The AtroCore user interface signs in by this client. It is set on the installation; the console command "restore ui client" restores it.

exceptions.userRequiredForClientCredentials: A client with the client credentials grant needs a user to act as.
exceptions.grantRequired: Select at least one way to obtain an access token: client credentials or authorization code.
exceptions.redirectUrisRequired: A client with the authorization code grant needs at least one redirect URI.
exceptions.invalidRedirectUri: "%s" is not a valid redirect URI: an absolute URI without a fragment is expected.
exceptions.uiClientProtected: The AtroCore user interface signs in by this client: only its name, description and activity can be changed.
exceptions.uiClientNotRemovable: The AtroCore user interface signs in by this client, it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it to turn off signing in to the user interface.

actionConfirms.generateSecret: A new client secret will be generated. The current secret stops working and the tokens issued to the client are revoked. Continue?

actionResults.generateSecret: The client secret is shown only once, copy it now:

messages.uiClientDisabled: Signing in to the user interface is turned off by the administrator.
messages.signInFailed: The sign-in did not succeed. Please sign in again.
messages.signInExpired: The sign-in has expired. Start it again in the application.
